name: Analytical Error Approximation for Edge-Crossing
definition: An analytical method to approximate the error of the edge-crossing vertex in MC algorithms to visualize the reconstructed isosurface error. It computes the estimated error directly from volume data without requiring sampling, ensemble data, or high-resolution targets.
summary: Analytical Error Approximation for Edge-Crossing estimates Marching Cubes geometric error from local scalar field gradients, offering a computationally efficient alternative to isosurface comparison methods.
